subject: Short pilot: APAC SLA uplift and pricing for add-on hours vs. tiered discount
messages:
From: Ava Rios <ava.rios@skyrun.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrun.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: APAC pilot — engineering hours vs tiered discount and SLA uplift

Hi Ben and Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Skyrun is excited to move from a sandbox to a short production pilot focused on our APAC customers (mainly Singapore and Sydney).

We have two commercial questions before procurement will sign off:
- We need an option to purchase a small bundle of dedicated engineering hours for integration/ops support during the 6-week pilot (separate from the standard support included).
- Alternatively, procurement would prefer a pricing ladder (tiered discount) tied to a short commit (e.g., 4 / 6 / 8 weeks) instead of buying hours upfront.

Related ask: for APAC workloads we need a 99.5% regional SLA and a short data residency attestation — are those add-ons that can be priced into the pilot, or do they require a Private deployment amendment?

Can you send options and ballpark numbers today/tomorrow? We need to share with legal and procurement for a decision meeting on Friday.

Thanks,
Ava

--
Ava Rios
Head of Product
Skyrun AI
ava.rios@skyrun.ai
+61 412 555 018
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Rios <ava.rios@skyrun.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrun.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: APAC pilot — engineering hours vs tiered discount and SLA uplift

Ava — thanks for the clear ask. High-level options below (ballparks included). Happy to tighten once Laura and Marcus confirm operational details.

Option A — Hour-bundle (recommended if you expect engineering touchpoints):
- 40 dedicated engineering hours (integration + on-call during pilot) — USD 18,000
- Includes 4 guaranteed on-call incidents (response within 2 hours) during pilot window
- Addendum: regional SLA uplift to 99.5% + data residency attestation — one-time add-on USD 4,500

Option B — Tiered discount (procurement-friendly):
- 4-week pilot: standard rate (no discount)
- 6-week pilot: 8% discount on usage and embedding units
- 8-week pilot: 12% discount on usage and embedding units
- SLA uplift and data residency attestation require the same one-time add-on (USD 4,500)

Operational notes: the SLA uplift is an operations/configuration commitment (route traffic through APAC region + monitoring). If you need data-residency written into contract we should loop legal for a short addendum; otherwise we can provide an attestation letter for the pilot.

Next steps:
- If you prefer Option A I can draft a short SOW and invoice for the 40 hours + SLA add-on.
- If you prefer Option B, let us know which pilot length and we’ll provide a revised order form with the laddered discount.

I’ve copied Laura for the SOW and Marcus for capacity planning.

Best,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0199
From: Ava Rios <ava.rios@skyrun.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@skyrun.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: APAC pilot — engineering hours vs tiered discount and SLA uplift

Thanks Ben — helpful. Procurement prefers Option B (tiered discount) because they want usage to be visible and auditable rather than a prepaid hours pool. That said, they want an option to purchase a small 12-hour block for emergency engineering support (we can escalate if we need more).

Two clarifications we need:
1) Can the 6-week (8% discount) be backdated to a 5-week scope if we choose an aggressive go-live schedule?
2) Is the one-time SLA add-on refundable or eligible for a credit if we convert to Dedicated within 60 days?

If you can confirm those two points, we’ll route to procurement today.

Ava
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ava Rios <ava.rios@skyrun.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: APAC pilot — engineering hours vs tiered discount and SLA uplift

Hi Ava — looping in the SOW and a couple of pricing tables so you can share with procurement (attached).

Short answers to your clarifying questions:
1) Backdating: we can offer the 6-week pricing for a 5-week effective service window if the pilot start date is within 7 days of signature — that flexibility is common for acceleration scenarios.
2) SLA add-on credit: if you convert to Dedicated within 60 days, we can apply the USD 4,500 as a credit toward your setup fee (not as a cash refund).

I attached:
- apac_sla_addendum_draft.pdf — draft language for an SLA uplift and data residency attestation (legal-friendly wording)
- pilot_pricing_options.xlsx — tabbed sheet with the hour-bundle vs laddered discount math

Please review and let us know which lane you want. If procurement picks the tiered-discount lane we’ll produce an order form with the ladder and a 12-hour emergency support add-on priced at USD 5,400.

On Friday I can join the procurement call if helpful.

Best regards,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Commercial Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick: APAC pilot — engineering hours vs tiered discount and SLA uplift

Internal summary (for our handoff to legal/finance):
- Customer (Skyrun) prefers Option B: tiered discount with a 12-hour emergency support add-on (USD 5,400).
- We can apply the SLA add-on (USD 4,500) as a credit toward Dedicated setup within 60 days.
- We will provide an order form reflecting the 6-week laddered discount (8%) but permit a 5-week effective window if signed within 7 days of the proposed start date.

Action items:
- Laura: please finalize the SOW/Order Form and upload to Drive (use the draft link I commented on).
- Marcus: confirm capacity in APAC and that we can meet the 2-hour on-call response SLT for the emergency add-on.
- Legal: prioritize a short addendum for the data residency attestation if procurement asks for signed text.

I’ll ping procurement with the order form once it’s ready.

Thanks —
Ben
